words: Count how many times the cat comes through the lounge today and tell me tonight.
Keep score while we play cards. I'll tell you who wins each round, like point to Sam.
Let's play Simon says!
Give me a quiz about animals, five questions.
Play red light green light with a twist.
Let's do a treasure hunt: I'll hide your ball and you find it.
Every morning, say hello to whoever's up first, and if it's been raining tell them to take a coat.
Count how many times the doorbell rings today and tell me at six.
Keep track of how many times the kettle goes on today and tell me at bedtime.
Tell me a bedtime story with your faces.
At seven tonight, ask me how my day was and just listen.
Every time Sam comes home today, count it and tell me at nine.
Every hour until five, remind me to stand up and stretch.
Count how many glasses of water I drink today. I'll say glass each time. Tell me the total at eight.
Count how many times you hear the dog crying this afternoon and tell me at five.
Let's play a guessing game: pick a number from 1 to 10 and I'll guess, and you tell me higher or lower.
Test my spelling with five words.
Quiz me on my seven times table.
Count how many people come home today and tell me at ten tonight.
For the next two weeks, remind me to water the plants on Monday and Thursday mornings.
Make a game: give me a tidy-up challenge every five minutes for half an hour.
Tell me a joke every time I come home today.
Count to twenty out loud for hide and seek, then say coming.
Play rock paper scissors with me, best of five.
Go and check the kitchen every hour until ten tonight.
Do a dance party: spin and wiggle for a bit, then say ta-da.
When Mo gets home today, say welcome home and ask how school was.
Count the knocks at the door while I nap, and tell me when I say I'm awake.
Keep a list of the chores I tell you today, and read them back when I say read my list.
At half past eight tonight, say goodnight to everyone who's here.
